name: Orgg
description: A Dominarian race of powerful, dumb hybrids between Orcs and Ogres, with green skin, batlike ears, massive teeth and two pairs of arms.

timeline.summary: Orggs are used in the war against Icatia by the goblin-orc alliance on Sarpadia around AR 170.
timeline.quote: On Sarpadia , Orggs were used in the war against Icatia by the goblin -orc alliance around AR 170.

timeline.summary: Orggs are known to exist on Otaria around 4050 AR, possibly created by the Cabal.
